DASHBOARD.WELCOME_DESC: A quick overview of the app so you can get organized right away without getting lost in the buttons.
DASHBOARD.HEADER_DESC: Switch the theme (light/dark) and language here, and access your profile settings.
DASHBOARD.STATS_DESC: See the essentials at the top: total items, sold items, lent items, and important reminders.
DASHBOARD.CREATE_BTN_DESC: Quickly add a new location or item from here at any time.
DASHBOARD.STATS_LOCATIONS_DESC: Shows how many rooms, cabinets, and boxes you have. Click to open the location list.
DASHBOARD.STATS_ITEMS_DESC: The total number of items. Click to open the full list with convenient search.
DASHBOARD.STATS_SALES_DESC: History of sold items and total earnings.
DASHBOARD.STATS_LENT_DESC: Items you gave to someone or borrowed from someone yourself.
DASHBOARD.STATS_ATTENTION_DESC: Important things appear here: expiring warranties, battery replacements, or scheduled tasks.
DASHBOARD.LOCATIONS_DESC: Quick tabs for instantly switching to the room, cabinet, or other location you need.
DASHBOARD.BOARD_DESC: Your storage locations are displayed here. Each card represents a separate room, shelf, or box.
DASHBOARD.CREATE_FIRST_DESC: Click here to create your first location (for example, "Garage" or "Bedroom") and start organizing your items.
DASHBOARD.FEEDBACK_BTN_DESC: Found a bug or have a cool feature idea? Let us know anytime.
DASHBOARD.FOOTER_DESC: Links to contacts, support, and rules are always available at the bottom of the page.

ITEMS_LIST.WELCOME_DESC: A convenient table with all items from all rooms and shelves.
ITEMS_LIST.FILTERS_DESC: Find what you need in seconds by name, category, location, or status.
ITEMS_LIST.TABLE_DESC: Select multiple items at once for deletion or edit each item individually.

SALES_LIST.WELCOME_DESC: History of all sold items with total revenue.
SALES_LIST.FINANCE_DESC: Shows total sales and net profit.
SALES_LIST.FILTERS_DESC: Sort transactions by date, platform (OLX, Prom), or category.
SALES_LIST.ACTIONS_DESC: Details of each sale. If a customer returns an item, you can move it back to storage with one click.

LOCATION_FORM.WELCOME_DESC: Create a storage location, such as a "Garage", "Hallway cabinet", or "Blue box".
LOCATION_FORM.NAME_DESC: Give it a clear name. If you are creating a shelf inside a cabinet, simply select that cabinet as its parent.
LOCATION_FORM.COLOR_DESC: Choose a color so the card stands out on the board and is easy to find at a glance.
LOCATION_FORM.CUSTOM_COLOR_DESC: The color picker lets you choose any shade you like.

ITEM_FORM.WELCOME_DESC: Fill in the essentials about the item: photos, location, warranty, and notes.
ITEM_FORM.PHOTO_DESC: Upload photos of the item (up to 5). Click on any photo to set it as the main one (marked with a star).
ITEM_FORM.NAME_DESC: Keep it simple (for example: "Bosch drill" or "Winter jacket").
ITEM_FORM.DESC_DESC: Add serial numbers, dimensions, included accessories, or where the spare keys are kept.
ITEM_FORM.CATEGORY_DESC: Group items (Tools, Clothing, Electronics) so you can easily keep track of them.
ITEM_FORM.ADD_CATEGORY_DESC: If the category you need is missing, click the plus button and add it while filling out the form.
ITEM_FORM.LOCATION_DESC: Specify the exact room, cabinet, or box where the item is currently stored.
ITEM_FORM.STATUS_DESC: 'Active' - the item is available for any actions: you can move, sell, or lend it. 'Lent' - you gave the item to someone. 'Borrowed' - you borrowed it yourself. The last two options will open an additional form (these items cannot be sold until returned).
ITEM_FORM.FINANCIALS_DESC: Enter the purchase price and date to keep track of how much money you have invested in your items.
ITEM_FORM.RECEIPT_DESC: Save the warranty expiration date and the app will remind you in advance when it is about to expire.
ITEM_FORM.REMINDER_DESC: Set up Telegram or Email notifications (for example: "Change the filter in 6 months").

FIRST_LOCATION_CARD.WELCOME_DESC: Great! Your first card is here. Let's see how to work with it.
FIRST_LOCATION_CARD.MAIN_ADD_ITEM_DESC: You can add an item from here or use the "Create" button at the top.
FIRST_LOCATION_CARD.HEADER_DESC: The top of the card contains buttons for viewing, editing the name and color, and deleting.
FIRST_LOCATION_CARD.ADD_NESTED_DESC: Click "Create Location" to put a shelf or box INSIDE this card.
FIRST_LOCATION_CARD.ADD_ITEM_DESC: Click "Create Item" to add an item directly to this location.

FIRST_ITEM_CARD.WELCOME_DESC: Great! Here is how you can interact with it.
FIRST_ITEM_CARD.DRAG_DESC: Drag the card with your mouse on your PC or use the «Move» option in the three-dot menu on your phone.
FIRST_ITEM_CARD.INFO_DESC: The eye icon opens the full item card with photos, documents, and details.
FIRST_ITEM_CARD.MENU_DESC: The three-dot menu lets you edit, lend, sell, or delete the item.

SELL_FORM.WELCOME_DESC: Record the price and sales platform so the item can be moved to the sales archive.
SELL_FORM.PRICE_DESC: The amount of money you received for the item.
SELL_FORM.DATE_DESC: Today's date is selected by default.
SELL_FORM.ADD_PLATFORM_DESC: Add a platform (OLX, Prom, Facebook) if it is not already in the list.
SELL_FORM.PLATFORM_DESC: Choose the website or place where the item was sold.

FIRST_SALE_CARD.WELCOME_DESC: Congratulations! The transaction has been saved successfully.
FIRST_SALE_CARD.INFO_DESC: Shows the date, platform, price, and your net profit.
FIRST_SALE_CARD.UNDO_DESC: If the sale falls through or the customer returns the item, click here to move it back to the board.

LANDING.HERO_TITLE: Bring order to your things once and for all
LANDING.HERO_SUBTITLE: INest is your digital organizer. Track item locations, warranties, sold, and lent items in a few clicks.
LANDING.FEATURE_1_DESC: Create structures of any complexity: Home -> Closet -> Second shelf. Find anything in seconds.
LANDING.FEATURE_2_DESC: Keep track of who borrowed your tools and how much you sold your old gear for.
LANDING.FEATURE_3_DESC: Search items, check status, and get reminders right inside the messenger.
